item.title: [Unsupervised Learning] Ep 93: CEO of Redwood Research Buck Shlegeris on OpenAI/HuggingFace Revelations, Fixing AI Safety & Takeover Odds
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:37 The OpenAI Hugging Face incident has dominated the discourse these past days. It feels straight out of a sci fi novel, some of the things that happened, you know, the agent coordination, the obsession with the scores, and and what they would want. And we had the perfect person on today to just discuss everything that happened and the implications for AI safety going forward in Buck Schlegeris, who's the CEO of Redwood Research.
